title: dylangrblr/vinotype pipeline parameters
description: A streamlined computational framework geared towards the effective, large-scale identification of sequence variants from Illumina short-read data for grapevine (Vitis spp.)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome FASTA and (optionally) pre-built indexes. If an index is not provided it is built at runtime from ref_fasta.

ref_fasta.description: Path or URL to the reference genome FASTA.

ref_intervals_list.description: Path or URL to the intervals list (one contig per line) used for scatter-gather.

ref_samtools_faidx.description: Pre-built samtools faidx (.fai) index. Built at runtime if omitted.

ref_samtools_dict.description: Pre-built sequence dictionary (.dict). Built at runtime if omitted.

ref_bwa_index.description: Pre-built BWA-MEM2 index directory. Built at runtime if omitted.

ref_fasta_genozip.description: Genozip reference (.ref.genozip) used when use_genozip is enabled.

pipeline_stage_options.title: Pipeline stage options
pipeline_stage_options.description: Toggle optional stages and alternate tools.

skip_gatk4_haplotypecaller_spark.description: Use the non-Spark GATK4 HaplotypeCaller instead of the Spark variant.

skip_merged_analysis.description: Stop after per-sample variant calling (skip joint genotyping, filtering and annotation).

skip_variant_annotation.description: Skip SnpEff variant annotation. Set to false and configure snpeff_db_name/snpeff_db/snpeff_config to enable.

base_genomicsdb.description: Existing GenomicsDB workspace to extend (incremental import). Creates a new DB if omitted.

snpeff_db.description: Path to the SnpEff data directory containing the genome database.

snpeff_config.description: Path to the SnpEff config file.

compression_options.title: Compression options
compression_options.description: Optional genozip compression of BAM/gVCF checkpoints (requires a license).

use_genozip.description: Enable genozip compression/decompression of BAM/gVCF checkpoints.

genozip_license_file.description: Path to the genozip license file (required when use_genozip is enabled).

variant_filtering_options.title: Variant filtering options
variant_filtering_options.description: Hard-filter thresholds applied to SNPs (bcftools expression).

filter_format_dp_fraction.description: Max fraction of samples allowed below filter_format_dp.

filter_gq_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of samples allowed to fall below filter_gq before variant is filtered.

filter_het_ad.description: Minimum alternate read depth (AD) required for heterozygous (0/1) genotype calls.

filter_het_ad_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of heterozygous samples (0/1) allowed to fall below filter_het_ad_fraction before the variant is excluded.

filter_hom_ad.description: Minimum alternate allele depth (AD) required for homozygous alternative (1/1) genotype calls.

filter_hom_ad_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of homozygous alternate samples allowed to fall below filter_hom_ad before the variant is filtered.

filter_het_vaf_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of heterozygous samples (0/1) allowed to fall below a variant allele frequency (VAF) threshold of 50% before the variant is excluded.

fastp_detect_adapter_for_pe.description: fastp: auto-detect adapters for paired-end reads.

fastp_unqualified_percent_limit.description: fastp: max % of unqualified bases allowed.

fastp_qualified_quality_phred.description: fastp: quality value a base is qualified at.

fastp_average_qual.description: fastp: minimum average read quality (0 = off).

fastp_n_base_limit.description: fastp: max number of N bases (0 = off).

fastp_trim_front1.description: fastp: bases to trim from the front of read 1.

fastp_trim_tail1.description: fastp: bases to trim from the tail of read 1.

fastp_trim_front2.description: fastp: bases to trim from the front of read 2.

fastp_trim_tail2.description: fastp: bases to trim from the tail of read 2.

fastp_length_required.description: fastp: minimum read length to keep.

fastp_poly_g_min_len.description: fastp: min length for polyG trimming (0 = off).

fastp_poly_x_min_len.description: fastp: min length for polyX trimming (0 = off).
